visualCharacteristics: A stack of collapsible panels, each with a clickable title bar and chevron that expands to show its content. Variants render product listing cards inside panels or stay open on desktop and collapse only on mobile.
contentPattern: One row per panel: [title heading or paragraph][body default content][optional flag cell: open to start expanded; with products also a #id anchor].
usage: Use it for FAQ-style or grouped content that readers expand panel by panel.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for any expandable panel list; pick tabs or columns when content should be visible at once.
